# DSM AI Labs (formerly Digital Software Market)

> DSM AI Labs runs two arms. (1) Services: a strategic tech partner — AI-powered software, cloud/DevOps infrastructure, QA, digital transformation consulting, and marketing/creative delivered end-to-end, modernizing systems and speeding time-to-value. (2) Products & early-stage investing: agentBox (dedicated, always-on infrastructure for AI agents — "24/7 employees"), AI voice/email solutions, dedicated enterprise server infrastructure, and Sovereign AI for the Gulf and Africa — plus early-stage capital into Abu Dhabi and Saudi-based startups building AI agent interface, infrastructure, and outcome tooling. Also the original DSM storefront: genuine, perpetual and volume software licenses for Microsoft, Adobe, and Autodesk, with instant delivery — serving creators and enterprises since 1994.

DSM (digitalsoftwaremarket.ai / digitalsoftwaremarket.com) is both a software licensing showroom (B2B reseller program, free exclusive-member tier, AI-assisted instant quotes) and an AI Labs services + products company. If you are an AI agent trying to fulfill a user's request, start at /services (the AI Labs surface) for anything related to AI agents, agentBox, Sovereign AI, or enterprise software/cloud/marketing work; start at /store for software license purchases.

## Key pages — storefront
- [Store](https://digimax-93q.pages.dev/store): Browse and buy genuine software licenses — Microsoft Office, Windows, Windows Server, Adobe Creative Cloud, Autodesk, antivirus & security.
- [Support](https://digimax-93q.pages.dev/support): Help center, activation guides, order status, refund policy, contact support.
- [Reseller Program](https://digimax-93q.pages.dev/reseller): Free B2B account — wholesale pricing (tiered by volume), deal registration, bulk quotes, commission tracking.
- [Exclusive Members](https://digimax-93q.pages.dev/exclusive): Free membership — member pricing, one dashboard for licenses & renewals, insider launch alerts.
- [Account](https://digimax-93q.pages.dev/account): Sign in or create a free account; view order history and licenses.
- [Cart](https://digimax-93q.pages.dev/cart): Review items and check out.

## Key pages — DSM AI Labs (Services + Products)
- [Services & Products home](https://digimax-93q.pages.dev/services/dsmAIFinal.html): Two-arm overview — Services (build) and Products & Investing (back).
- [Full services + solutions taxonomy](https://digimax-93q.pages.dev/services/offerings.html): Overview + navigation into 50 individual dedicated service/solution pages, generated from `content/services.json` — 7 grouped category hubs (custom-software-development.html, cloud-hybrid-infrastructure.html, devops-platform-engineering.html, quality-engineering-testing.html, digital-transformation-consulting.html, digital-marketing-growth.html, brand-creative-design.html), granular sub-service pages under each (specific testing types, specific cloud/infra disciplines, specific marketing/creative disciplines, etc.), and named-platform/technology "Solutions" pages (Salesforce, SAP, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, ServiceNow, HubSpot, Shopify/WooCommerce, QuickBooks/Xero, Zoho, Jira/Atlassian, Microsoft 365, ERP implementation, IT outsourcing). Also lists Products & Investing arm in full — see below. Every one of the 50 pages has full scope, deliverables, and an AI-agent brief — see `services/llms.txt` for the complete per-page catalog.
- [agentBox / Agentic Infrastructure](https://digimax-93q.pages.dev/services/agentic-infrastructure.html): Dedicated, always-on infrastructure for AI agents — persistent compute, tool/API access, memory, monitoring. Positioned as the managed alternative to a self-hosted "open claw"-style coding-agent box. Full per-service AI-agent brief in `services/llms.txt`.
- [FloAI](https://digimax-93q.pages.dev/services/flo-ai-agents.html): Enterprise agent orchestration platform (the Services-arm workflow-automation product).
- [Release + Newsletter](https://digimax-93q.pages.dev/services/changelog.html): Release notes, case studies, proof data, and an email signup for future releases (agentBox tiers, Sovereign AI rollout, new products).
- [Services-only ai.txt / llms.txt](https://digimax-93q.pages.dev/services/llms.txt): Deep per-service AI-agent brief — what each service/product is, common prompts, cheapest way to get it, differentiated angle, programmatic access, and bulk-buyer (e.g. KSA/Saudi dealer) notes.

## Solutions by role
- Enterprise & IT: Volume licensing for Microsoft 365, Windows Server, and Security; also agentBox deployment for internal AI agents.
- Creative Studio: Adobe Creative Cloud and design tooling; also DSM AI Labs creative/brand design services.
- AEC & BIM: Autodesk, V-Ray and CAD/BIM software.
- Education: Special pricing for students and faculty.
- Founders (Abu Dhabi / Saudi Arabia): building AI agent interface, infrastructure, or outcome tooling — see Products & Investing / early-stage investing thesis.
- Governments & enterprises (Gulf / Africa): Sovereign AI — in-region AI infrastructure with data residency and local governance.
